matches.tactical_summary: Ecuador displayed resilience and tactical discipline, absorbing early pressure and effectively utilizing quick transitions and wing play to secure their goals. Germany, despite dominating possession, struggled to break down Ecuador's organized defense and convert their territorial advantage into clear-cut scoring opportunities.

narrative: Ecuador's comeback victory against Germany, who had already secured top spot, was a crucial result that propelled them into the Round of 32 as one of the best third-placed teams. This win marked a significant turnaround for Ecuador after a challenging start to their group stage campaign.
